caption: Under a partly cloudy sky, an outdoor concrete skatepark holds a long white curved chute propped diagonally, its upper end gripped by a hand that tilts a clear cup full of small multicolored beads. A sneaker is partly visible at the right edge, and a concrete ramp face fills the left foreground. From the cup, beads spill onto the top of the chute and creep downward. They form a short trailing line of red, green, yellow and blue pieces just below the rim. A single leading blue bead edges along the white surface, moving ahead of the cluster as the segment progresses. The cluster behind it also shifts downward, with more beads emerging from the tilted cup. The hand, the cup and the chute remain largely fixed in screen position, while the lower length of the chute remains empty. Two faint blue smudges on the left ramp are visible at the start and then fade. The flow continues steadily, the leading bead still well above the empty lower chute as the last frame holds.
